cases.text: A peaceful park right by the river with lovely, nature themed granite bollards and ground plates by artist William Reimann.

I've learned from their narratives that the atmosphere is one of peaceful contemplation and serene civic pride, making it an exceptional spot for runners, casual walkers, or anyone needing a quiet moment to read or watch the boats.
One of those small, quiet spaces that you don't expect to see but help give the surrounding neighborhood some character.
It manages to feel like a working, living community despite being one of the most famous tourist destinations in Massachusetts.
Always great safe place 👍 to meet friends and neighbors 😉 I recommend to sit and enjoy the sun 😎☀️ 7days a week!
Peaceful cute bit of green space
It's a beautiful space with plenty of shade in the hot days to sit under and dog hours in the morning.
A great playground with lots of street parking.
The road is closed to auto traffic from the last Sunday in April through the second Sunday in November and during Saturday festivals.
Nice gated park with lots of toys for public use, such as walkers and cars
This one is close to Central Square but a little off the beaten path.
There is a playground that I'm sure is lovely in the summer.
I just ate there and, it was a very disappointing meal.
The lights are so beautiful and calming
We were there for the "everyone eats" event.
Nice spot for a bike break and a snack.
Very nice park, very clean facilities.
Cute park, but it does need a cleaning.
